subject: Pen test follow-up: remediation plan & ETAs for authz, logging, network
messages:
From: Alex Trent <alex.trent@acme-fin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up on PT report — evidence & remediation ETAs

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for sending the pen test report last week (we reviewed the PDF and notes). A few high-priority items came up during our internal review that we need explicit remediation timelines and supporting evidence for before our compliance committee sign-off. The items we care most about are:

- Authorization / privilege escalation (several findings where horizontal privilege checks were missing)
- Sensitive logging gaps (PII redaction and long-term retention controls)
- Network segmentation (east-west rules for prod-only workloads)
- Secrets disclosure risk from CI pipelines

Can you provide:
1) A short remediation plan for each of the items above (what will be changed, owner, and proposed ETA)
2) Any interim evidence we can use (test results, patch diffs, config snippets)
3) Whether the fixes will require downtime or config migration windows (and suggested windows)

We are on a tight timeline — our compliance committee meets 2026-07-20. If you can get a plan by early next week that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex Trent
Sr. Security Engineer
Acme Financial

Attachment: acme_review_notes_0629.docx (referenced)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Trent <alex.trent@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up on PT report — remediation plan & ETAs

Alex —

Appreciate the clear priorities. Attached is a concise remediation tracker and an initial set of artifacts we can share immediately. Summary below; full details are in the tracker (remediation_tracker_acme_20260701.xlsx).

High-level remediation plan (owners + ETAs):

1) Authorization (horizontal privilege checks)
   - Root cause: missing enforcement at service-level for some older endpoints; authz relied only on client-supplied namespace.
   - Action: deploy middleware authz enforcement and add automated unit/integration tests for role scoping.
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor (Engineering Security Lead) / Eng oncall (TBD)
   - ETA: staged rollout to prod by 2026-07-15; full coverage tests by 2026-07-18
   - Downtime: none; progressive rollout with feature flag.

2) Logging (PII redaction + retention)
   - Root cause: legacy ingestion pipeline stored raw user metadata in debug logs for 30d.
   - Action: implement redaction filters at ingestion + amend log retention policy to 90d with access controls; add alert for PII logging events.
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor / Logging Platform team
   - ETA: redaction filters deployed by 2026-07-10; retention policy change live by 2026-07-12
   - Downtime: maintenance window not required; backfill safe-delete job scheduled for 2026-07-13 (low risk).

3) Network segmentation (east-west rules)
   - Root cause: permissive security group defaults between legacy prod clusters and infra tooling nodes.
   - Action: apply tightened SG rules, enable host-based firewall for management plane, and run segmentation tests.
   - Owner: Infrastructure Security (Neha) + Network Ops
   - ETA: rules in staging 2026-07-09; prod enforcement 2026-07-16 (4am-6am PT maintenance window recommended)
   - Downtime: expected <30 minutes for rolling firewall apply, will use canary hosts.

4) Secrets in CI pipelines
   - Root cause: occasional echoing of environment variables in build logs and use of legacy vault tokens.
   - Action: mask build logs, rotate vault tokens, enforce vault-agent for pipeline access, add pre-flight scanners.
   - Owner: CI Platform / Neha
   - ETA: token rotation + masking 2026-07-08; full pipeline integration 2026-07-20
   - Downtime: none; short CI schedule freeze during rotation window (2 hours).

Artifacts attached: pt_report_acme_apr2026.pdf (original PT), remediation_tracker_acme_20260701.xlsx (detailed tasks), patch_diff_authz_20260702.patch (initial authz middleware diff). We can produce config snippets and test evidence as tasks complete — tracker has links to specific deliverables per finding.

Please confirm if these ETAs meet your committee timeline or if you need compression on any item. Karthik — looping you in to keep ACME informed on schedule and potential impacts for any commitments.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation_tracker_acme_20260701.xlsx; patch_diff_authz_20260702.patch; pt_report_acme_apr2026.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ACME PT follow-up — owners, blockers, and required signoffs

Team —

Per ACME's request (thread below), please see the plan and owners I sent them yesterday. I need the following from Engineering this week so we can hit the ETAs:

Action items (owner / ask / deadline):
- Authorization middleware deployment: Neha — confirm owner for implementation (engineer name) and provide PR link by 2026-07-05. If owner bandwidth is an issue, escalate and I'll reassign.
- Logging redaction rules: Neha — provide the ingestion filter config and a short test log (sanitized) by 2026-07-08. We need to show a before/after sample.
- Network segmentation: NetOps — run segmentation test plan and provide test report by 2026-07-12. If external firewall changes are necessary, indicate change window.
- Secrets rotation: CI Platform — schedule token rotation and provide rotation audit log (screenshot or export) post-rotation by 2026-07-09.

Blockers I know about:
- Some older microservices lack automated integration tests; Neha, please flag any that will require manual verification.
- NetOps has a dependency with a third-party managed firewall (ticket in vendor portal) — if vendor leads > 5 business days, we may need a compensating control.

Karthik — please prepare a short digest for ACME execs on impact to the deployment schedule if any of these dates slip. We want to avoid surprises ahead of their compliance committee meeting.

I'll keep the remediation tracker updated and will push artifacts to the shared drive folder.

Thanks —
Soojin

Quoted: "Re: Follow-up on PT report — evidence & remediation ETAs" from Alex (06/30)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME PT follow-up — owners, blockers, and required signoffs

Soojin —

Quick status update from Engineering:

- Authorization middleware: Engineer assigned (Priya N.) — PR opened (link in tracker). Initial unit tests cover 70% of endpoints. We'll finish integration tests and begin canary rollout on 2026-07-12. New ETA for full coverage: 2026-07-18 (reconciles with your plan).
- Logging redaction: Filters implemented in staging; sample sanitized logs attached in the tracker. Redaction rules deployment to prod scheduled 2026-07-10 as planned.
- Network segmentation: NetOps completed staging tests; vendor change window confirmed for 2026-07-16 04:00-06:00 PT. Expect <30m interruption to management-plane traffic only.
- Secrets rotation: Masking enabled on CI, token rotation scheduled for 2026-07-09 02:00 PT; audit export will be available after rotation.

Notes on evidence: we can provide the following incrementally to ACME as separate artifacts:
- Authz PR diff + passing integration test logs (after canary)
- Sanitized log samples and retention policy change doc
- NetOps segmentation test report and firewall change ticket
- CI rotation audit log and pipeline scanner reports

No major blockers at this time; vendor timeline for firewall is confirmed. If ACME needs earlier evidentiary artifacts, we can provide the staging test logs for review.

-Neha
Engineering Security Lead
Redwood Inference
